content.short: Anima is a decentralized identity protocol enabling users to decentralize and self-manage identity attributes.
content.description: Anima is a decentralized identity protocol. It enables users to decentralize and self-manage identity attributes such as proof of personhood or official identity proofs including passports or ID cards. Users can share specific attributes without disclosing their full ID. Anima enables new fair systems for web3 such as Fairdrops or democratic models for DAOs including one member one vote. Communities can also create claims and badges for reputation systems.
